titleEnglish: Yā Nabī Salām ʿAlayka — Anta Shamsun version

verses.ar:
يَا نَبِي سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا حَبِيبْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهْ عَلَيْكَ
verses.tr: Yā Nabī salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūl salām ʿalayka · Yā Ḥabīb salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūlallāh · Ṣalawātullāh ʿalayka
verses.en: O Prophet, peace be upon you; O Messenger, peace be upon you; O Beloved, peace be upon you; O Messenger of Allah — the blessings of Allah be upon you.

verses.ar:
أَنْتَ شَمْسٌ أَنْتَ بَدْرٌ
أَنْتَ نُورٌ فَوْقَ نُورِ
أَنْتَ إِكْسِيرٌ وَغَالِي
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
أَنْتَ مِصْبَاحُ الصُّدُورِ
verses.tr: Anta shamsun anta badrun · Anta nūrun fawqa nūri · Anta iksīrun wa-ghālī · Yā Rasūlallāh · Anta miṣbāḥu-ṣ-ṣudūri
verses.en: You are a sun, you are a full moon; you are light upon light; you are the precious quintessence, O Messenger of Allah; you are the lamp within every chest.

verses.ar:
يَا حَبِيبِي يَا مُحَمَّد
يَا عَرُوسَ الْخَافِقَيْنِ
يَا مُؤَيَّد يَا مُمَجَّد
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
يَا إِمَامَ الْقِبْلَتَيْنِ
verses.tr: Yā ḥabībī yā Muḥammad · Yā ʿarūsa-l-khāfiqayni · Yā mu'ayyad yā mumajjad · Yā Rasūlallāh · Yā imāma-l-qiblatayni
verses.en: O my beloved, O Muhammad ﷺ; O bridegroom of the East and the West; O you whom Allah supported and exalted; O Messenger of Allah; O Imam of the two directions of prayer.

verses.ar:
يَا اَللّٰهُ يَا مُحَمَّد
يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيق
يَا عُمَرْ عُثْمَانْ يَا عَلِي
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
فَاطِمَة بِنْتِ الرَّسُولِ
verses.tr: Yā Allāhu yā Muḥammad · Yā Abā Bakrini-ṣ-Ṣiddīq · Yā ʿUmar ʿUthmān yā ʿAlī · Yā Rasūlallāh · Fāṭima binti-r-Rasūli
verses.en: O Allah, O Muhammad ﷺ; O Abu Bakr the ever-truthful; O Umar, Uthman, O Ali; O Messenger of Allah; O Fatima, daughter of the Messenger.
